title: Reasons for Crown Failures in Primary Teeth: Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

answer.design_quote: Data from the included RCTs were used for meta-analysis, wherein 3-year and 5-year crown-retention rates were estimated using Poisson regression models.
answer.k_quote: This systematic review included 13 RCTs and 5 clinical studies on dental crowns for primary teeth, involving 454 children (1172 crowns) in RCTs and 810 children (2667 crowns) in clinical studies.
